name: BerniePortal
summary: BerniePortal is an HR platform whose one published edition, Starter, costs $5 per employee per month plus a $25 base fee and includes benefits and COBRA administration. Employers can set different plans, contributions and eligibility rules for each subgroup, and the vendor says its operations team builds plans in about three business days and that elections flow directly to carriers. Add-ons for PTO, time, performance and payroll are priced on request.

facts.text: Starter Edition costs $5 per employee per month plus a $25 base fee and includes recruiting, onboarding, benefits, compliance and COBRA administration.
Per the pricing page, no minimum employee count is listed; the $25 base fee is the only stated minimum.
The vendor says its operations team completes a plan buildout in about 3 business days, and that buyers do not need a broker.
Employers can set different plans, contributions and eligibility rules for each subgroup, such as class, location or department.
The compliance feature page mentions ACA only in an FAQ about notices and does not describe ACA measurement or 1095-C reporting.

plans.name: Starter Edition
